levels.surface: أبي قتادة علي بن محمد بن حفص

notes: «عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link: the brother's relation folds into the name; «قال: قلت» makes Ali ibn Ja'far the asker and Musa the answering Imam, the last link
«أبي قتادة علي بن محمد بن حفص» is read as one man (kunya and name, joined by «و» to the level's other co-transmitter); flagged uncertain
